comment: A78 independent C-first monster-to-monster entry route. The source-checked #wizintrinsic menu input grants Conflict; a hostile ghoul and three hostile paper golems are then generated on the same level, so monmove.c's monster-turn conflict path can invoke mhitm.c:mattackm and uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_plys. Twenty bounded wait opportunities are frozen from that source route, not from JavaScript output. The selected recording must show a C annotation at uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_plys before it can be used as evidence.
